editorial.blurb: Neta Sushi in Park Ridge delivers consistently fresh, beautifully presented sushi with creative specialty rolls and genuinely welcoming service that keeps guests coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the "Neta Delux" sashimi and nigiri assortment for excellent value (~$50), and ask your server for recommendations—they're genuinely knowledgeable and eager to guide you.

topDishes.note: Buttery, fresh, soft with a perfectly balanced sauce
10-pc sashimi, 6-pc nigiri, and two rolls—thick cuts and excellent value
